items.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I knew I’d mispronounce that but I thought, “Oh that’s interesting she wrote a song about a law firm.”

ctx.x: I saw this song title and — “Hadron, Meson, Baryon”

Thank you. I knew I’d mispronounce that but I thought, “Oh that’s interesting she wrote a song about a law firm.” So you know I did some digging and where did the idea to write about subatomic particles come from?
